cards.title: GARAGE FOUNDER
cards.concept: young founder in a grey zip hoodie over a crisp collared shirt, hugging a battered laptop to his chest with a paper coffee cup in the other hand, a cheap earpiece with one tiny cyan LED
cards.hook: day one of Compute Labs, which he launched in 2024 around a GPU real-world-asset vision

cards.title: RACK RUNNER
cards.concept: night-shift data-centre tech in a grey utility coverall with a lanyard access badge on his chest and a coil of network cable slung over one shoulder
cards.hook: the GPUs his company tokenises live in server racks like these

cards.title: ARCADE MECHANIC
cards.concept: arcade repair tech in a worn grey work jacket with rolled sleeves, holding up a scuffed retro gamepad with a frayed cable, a small screwdriver in his breast pocket
cards.hook: his gaming-industry roots at Delysium, rct.AI and Xsolla

cards.title: CREDCHIP COURIER
cards.concept: courier in a grey techwear windbreaker with a messenger-bag strap across his chest, holding up a small credit chip between two fingers, a cheap wrist display with one tiny cyan LED
cards.hook: Xsolla moves the money of the games industry; payments were part of his trade before compute

cards.title: CAMPUS HACKER
cards.concept: student hacker in a grey windbreaker with a backpack strap over one shoulder, clutching a slim terminal slate to his chest, glasses on and a focused half-smile
cards.hook: UCLA and Caltech, where the sharp mind behind the company was trained

cards.title: GPU DRONE JOCKEY
cards.concept: drone pilot in grey techwear with green terminal-code piping and a green-lit wrist controller, a small quad drone carrying a GPU card hovering just above his shoulder
cards.hook: Compute Labs' business is GPUs, and every tokenised card has a real owner to deliver to

cards.title: AI WHISPERER
cards.concept: calm operator in a dark jacket with green circuit trim and a tiny implant on his temple, a small green holographic AI companion sprite perched on his raised hand
cards.hook: rct.AI and Delysium put him where games and AI meet

cards.title: ON-CHAIN FIXER
cards.concept: fixer in a sharp dark bomber jacket with green terminal-code piping, holding a compact cyberdeck of scrolling green code at his chest with a data cable running into a jack on his wrist
cards.hook: tokenising GPUs as real-world assets means putting compute on-chain

cards.title: OVERCLOCKER
cards.concept: overclocker in a green-trimmed techwear vest holding a liquid-cooled GPU block with a looping green coolant tube, a thin cable implant on the back of his hand
cards.hook: squeezing every cycle out of the GPUs Compute Labs is built on

cards.title: CORPO EXEC
cards.concept: immaculate corporate executive in a black armoured three-piece suit with glowing teal seams, holding a chrome briefcase open at his chest to reveal a softly glowing cyan GPU inside
cards.hook: the sharp-suited CEO whose deal on the table is the GPU itself, as a real-world asset

cards.title: TENSOR SAMURAI
cards.concept: street samurai in a sleek armoured long coat with glowing teal seams and a high collar, a katana of cyan light resting on his shoulder with its blade rising behind his head
cards.hook: composed, sharp and quietly determined, wielding a blade named for the tensor cores AI runs on

cards.title: NEURAL NETRUNNER
cards.concept: elite netrunner in a teal-seamed armoured coat, a thick data cable running from a small implant on his temple over his shoulder to a faintly glowing cyan cyberdeck held at his chest
cards.hook: UCLA and Caltech brainpower jacked straight into the neural net

cards.title: CHROME TYCOON
cards.concept: chrome-augmented tycoon in a violet-lined dark suit with polished chrome shoulder plates, large holographic market panels of violet bars and hot-pink candlesticks floating behind his shoulders
cards.hook: building a market where GPU compute trades as an on-chain real-world asset

cards.title: GRID ARCHITECT
cards.concept: architect of the machine city in chrome shoulder armour over a deep violet high-collared coat, a towering violet holographic wireframe of a server hall rising behind him with hot-pink neon rack lights
cards.hook: the data centres full of GPUs are the city his company is building on

cards.title: ASCENDED FOUNDER
cards.concept: ascended founder in white-chrome and gold high-collared regalia, three concentric golden circuit rings studded with glowing GPU cores orbiting behind his head like a halo, a radiant golden data aura streaming up around his silhouette
cards.hook: every GPU core in his halo is a real-world asset on-chain: the vision he launched Compute Labs in 2024 to build
